sources.name: OpenStreetMap (Overpass API)
sources.notes: Ways 280009642, 525886322, 502869479, 502869477, 502869476, 502869478, 28209618 joined in race order (Via Aurelia (SS1), Via Duca d'Aosta (SP55), Via Val d'Olivi) and trimmed to the route; projected EPSG:4326->7791 with pyproj; OSM base 2026-10-29T21:11:08Z. ODbL.

sources.name: Regione Liguria – DTM e DSM First derivati da LiDAR (maps 1909, 1913), 1 m
sources.notes: PST LiDAR 2008-2010 (MATTM), delivered as GeoTIFF by Regione Liguria's download service and resampled bilinearly to the 1 m EPSG:7791 near grid. Canopy = max(DSM First − DTM, 0). CC BY 4.0.

sources.name: Regione Liguria – Carta Tecnica Regionale 1:5000 2007/2013 II Ed. 3D / DB Topografico (M1237)
sources.notes: WFS 2.0.0, layers M1237:L3150, M1237:L3152, M1237:L3175, M1237:L3190, M1237:L3189, reprojected by the server to EPSG:7791; orthometric heights (Genova 1942), 0.6 m precision. Checks the LiDAR's vertical datum (road-area heights); the road-area polygons' edges centre the route on the surveyed carriageway. CC BY 4.0.

sources.name: TINITALY/1.1 DEM 10 m (INGV)
sources.notes: WCS 2.0.1 GetCoverage (https://tinitaly.pi.ingv.it/TINItaly_1_1/wcs), 10 m in WGS 84 / UTM 32N, bare earth. The far grid at 10 m (the near grid block-averaged inside its footprint), the horizon at 50 m over 40 km. Its nodata is the sea. CC BY 4.0.

sources.name: AGEA – Ortofoto a colori 2022 sc. 1:5000, via Regione Liguria (M2555)
sources.notes: WMS layer M2555:L10401 (summer 2022) resampled by the server to 0.5 m/px over the near grid and 2.5 m/px over the far grid (CourseTextures/poggio_ortho_far.jpg). AGEA flight, summer 2022, native 0.2 m (sharp to ~0.4 m); shadows fall to the north-west (a morning flight). By AGEA (Agenzia per le Erogazioni in Agricoltura), served by Regione Liguria. AGEA releases its 2022-2024 RGB orthophotos under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/; https://geoportale.agea.gov.it/legal-notes). Changed here: cropped to the near and far grids and resampled; in CourseTextures/poggio_ortho_ground.jpg the trees, roofs, the photo's shadows and the sea are also painted out and the colours adjusted (textures/bake_course_maps.py).

sources.name: Regione Liguria – Linea di costa 2022 (M2274:L10350)
sources.notes: Cuts the near grid's sea along the 2022 coastline; the sea holds -1 m on every terrain grid and no canopy. CC BY 4.0.

sources.name: Milano-Sanremo 2026 course GPX (cyclingstage.com) + RCS 2026 Poggio profile (milanosanremo.it)
sources.notes: Race direction and streets: Via Aurelia (SS1), Via Duca d'Aosta (SP55), Via Val d'Olivi. Poggio di Sanremo 3.7 km, 136 m, 3.7 % average, max 8 %, from 24 m (SS1 Aurelia) to 160 m; 4 hairpins in the first 2 km (RCS, milanosanremo.it/en/tappe/milano-sanremo-2026/).
